description:
Cast Flesh Duplicate by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Ratadrabik.
Put Flesh Duplicate into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Flesh Duplicate dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a token copy of Flesh Duplicate that is a copy of Ratadrabik but is a 2/2 Zombie in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 2 using the Flesh Duplicate token instead.
